newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on dollar speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on dollar speculation.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower at 58.90 to the dollar, after opening at 58.87, on speculative demand for dollars, dealers said.
"There was no commercial demand for dollars as the market is yet to recover from the recent holidays," said a Union Bank dealer.
The forex market was closed for four days until Wednesday for Sinhala and Tamil new year.
"There were a few banks buying dollars on speculation and since the market was thin the movement was exaggerated," the dealer said.
Overnight call money rates closed at 8.5 percent, after opening at 8.75 and risisng to nine, dealers said.
